To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) secondary attributes are attributes whose values are dependent upon the values of other attributes, and (2) the specification of secondary attributes should be included in a formal object-oriented specification, because the presence of secondary attributes has a significant impact on the semantics of a system.

Secondary attributes can be used to improve the clarity of the specification of a system by indicating which attributes of an object are primary (independently specified), and which are secondary, (dependent on the values of other attributes).
secondary attributes are a valuable concept for object-oriented specification and that the use of secondary attributes can be formalized.
In summary, our research is concerned with

1) the identification of secondary attributes; 2) the specification of secondary attributes in terms of the primary attributes and other secondary attributes; 3) the use of secondary attributes to specify the semantics of operations on an object and the behaviour of an object; 4) the use of the secondary attributes as the basis for the specification of object behaviour.
the use of secondary attributes in the specification of complex systems and the implications for specification clarity, completeness and correctness of the resulting specification.

secondary attributes are a useful tool for the object-oriented modeller.
